exact: G-protein signalling, phospholipase D activating pathway
phospholipase D-activating G-protein coupled receptor signaling pathway
related: activation of phospholipase D activity by G-protein coupled receptor protein signaling pathway

definition: A G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway in which the signal is transmitted via the activation of phospholipase D (PLD) and a subsequent increase in the intracellular concentration of phosphatidic acid (PA).
label: phospholipase D-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway
